page.title: Marbella Yacht Charter for Ironman 2052 Recovery

data.meta_description: Recover like a champion with a Marbella yacht charter for Ironman 2052. Book a luxury boat in Puerto Banús from €749/2h. Relax, swim, and restore.
data.summary: A practical guide to using a Marbella yacht charter as the ultimate Ironman 2052 recovery day. Covers boat options, recovery benefits, itinerary ideas, and booking details from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What is the best boat for a post-Ironman recovery day?
faq.a: For a small group, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (both 12.5m) offer comfortable seating, a swim platform, and a shaded cockpit – perfect for stretching and relaxing. If you want extra space and a jet ski to play on, the Mangusta 80 (24m) is a superb choice, though it requires a 4-hour minimum charter.

faq.q: How much does a recovery yacht charter cost in Marbella?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT. The Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a jet ski. For other boats, prices are available on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can I swim and snorkel during the charter?
faq.a: Absolutely. Most charters include stops at calm coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, where you can swim in crystal-clear water. Life jackets and snorkelling equipment are typically available on board. The skipper will choose the best spots based on sea conditions.

faq.q: Do you provide food and drinks on board?
faq.a: Yes, every charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. For longer charters, you can also bring your own food or arrange a catered menu – just let us know in advance.

faq.q: Is the skipper included in the price?
faq.a: Yes, a licensed skipper is included on every charter. They handle navigation, anchoring, and safety, so you can fully relax and focus on recovery. Fuel, insurance, and safety equipment are also covered.

faq.q: How do I book a recovery yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: You can book directly via WhatsApp for most boats. For the Astondoa 40, Azimut 39, and Mangusta 80, you can also request a fixed-price quote online. We recommend booking at least a few days in advance, especially during Ironman week.

faq.q: What should I bring for my recovery day on a yacht?
faq.a: Bring swimwear, a towel, sunscreen, a hat, and comfortable clothing. If you plan to stretch or do light yoga, a mat is helpful. Also bring a change of clothes and any personal recovery aids like compression gear or electrolyte tablets.

data.body_html:
After crossing the Ironman 2052 finish line, your body deserves more than a hotel bed. A Marbella yacht charter for Ironman 2052 recovery is the ultimate way to ease sore muscles, calm your mind, and celebrate your achievement in style. Departing from Puerto Banús, our fleet offers everything from agile speedboats to luxurious superyachts – all with a licensed skipper, drinks, snacks, and insurance included. Whether you want a gentle cruise along the Golden Mile or a swim stop in a secluded cove, the Mediterranean is your recovery pool.

Why a yacht is the perfect recovery day

Active recovery is proven to reduce muscle stiffness and improve circulation. A day on the water combines low-impact movement (swimming, walking on deck) with total relaxation. The sea breeze, the sound of waves, and the warm Andalusian sun lower cortisol and boost endorphins. Unlike a gym session or a long walk, a yacht charter lets you choose your effort level: float, swim, stretch, or simply nap on the foredeck.

Our recovery-ready fleet

We operate from Puerto Banús, so every charter starts in the heart of Marbella’s luxury marina. Here are the standout options for a post-race recovery day:

For a small group, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are ideal – spacious decks, a swim platform, and a shaded cockpit. If you want to add a bit of fun, the Mangusta 80 includes a jet ski, perfect for a gentle ride (or a thrill if your legs have recovered). For larger groups, the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86 offer supreme comfort. See our full [fleet and booking options](/).

Sample recovery itinerary (4–8 hours)

Here’s how a typical recovery charter unfolds, tailored to your pace:

  • 10:00 – Board at Puerto Banús. Welcome drink (cava or water) and a quick safety briefing.
  • 10:30 – Cruise east towards Cabopino or west towards Estepona. The skipper will pick a smooth route with minimal chop.
  • 11:30 – Anchor at a calm cove like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Time for a gentle swim, snorkelling, or just floating on the surface.
  • 13:00 – Light lunch on board: our snacks plus anything you’ve brought. Soft drinks, beer, and white wine are always cold.
  • 14:00 – Sunbathe on the foredeck or stretch in the shade. Some guests do simple yoga on the aft deck – the gentle motion is surprisingly therapeutic.
  • 15:30 – Slow cruise back, taking in views of La Concha mountain and the Golden Mile.
  • 16:00 – Disembark, feeling restored and still buzzing from your race.

What’s included in every charter

No hidden costs. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper (fuel included)
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

That means the price you see is the price you pay. For the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39, that’s €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, with a jet ski thrown in. All other boats are priced on request – just message us on WhatsApp.

Recovery tips on board

Make the most of your yacht time with these evidence-backed recovery moves:

  • Swim gently – 10–15 minutes of easy swimming increases blood flow without stressing joints.
  • Stretch on deck – Use the railing for calf and hamstring stretches. The stable platform of a flybridge is ideal.
  • Hydrate – Alternate water with electrolyte drinks. We provide plenty of water, but bring your own electrolyte sachets if you prefer.
  • Compression gear – Wear compression socks or tights during the cruise to aid venous return.
  • Sleep – The gentle rocking of the boat is a natural sleep aid. Grab a shaded spot and doze for 20–30 minutes.

Book your recovery charter

Ready to turn your Ironman 2052 finish into an unforgettable memory? Book your Marbella yacht charter for Ironman 2052 recovery today. For the Astondoa 40, Azimut 39, or Mangusta 80, you can book directly online. For any other boat, contact us via WhatsApp for a personalised quote. We’re based in Puerto Banús, and our team will help you choose the perfect vessel for your group size and budget. Don’t wait – race week books up fast. Start planning your recovery now at [our yacht charter hub](/).
